source: Measured: the reference self-calibrating compensator (solution/oracle: per instrument, joint angles from the stereo endoscope video by fitting the instrument's meshes (MuJoCo segmentation renders of a window around the wrist, two samples per pixel per axis) to the frames' metal coverage, with the pixels that are metal in nearly every frame and are not the shaft (the assistant's still instrument) left out; the endoscope pose calibrated from the video (a scan of the turn about the shaft, a joint refinement over 40 frames, a scan along the flattest remaining direction); frames fitted clearly worse than typical, or that disagree with the motor-log model, re-fitted from its prediction; trimmed Prandtl-Ishlinskii lost-motion models with pitch-dependent play fitted from the motor log, inverted episode after episode from the play states the recording left, plus servo-lag inversion) scored tip_rmse_mm = 0.0523 over 8 hidden instruments and 48 episodes in ale validate run validate-f942effd (2026-11-27); the program took 317 to 489 s per instrument in the 2-CPU, 4 GB sandbox.
note: full_at: the instruments differ, so the reference's score depends on which eight are drawn. Over 40 further instruments (seeds 8001-8040, the grader's own code, local runs) the reference scored 0.0247 to 0.0605 mm per instrument, and 0.168 mm on one whose endoscope pose it gets about 0.5 degrees wrong about the pitch axis (a turn only the shaft's perspective tells); over random sets of eight of them its pooled RMS gives a ratio 0.0523 / RMS whose 0.01%, 0.1% and 1% quantiles are 0.695, 0.704 and 0.718. At full_at 0.70 about 2 in 10,000 such sets of the reference fall short of full reward. From the joints' true angles the same identification scores 0.022 to 0.036 mm; with settled starts assumed instead of the carried play states, 0.022 to 0.050 mm. The stock firmware misses by 2 to 5 mm. Confirmed with these values in validate-9ee3bdbe (commit 533c2a54: 0.0390 mm over eight other hidden instruments, ratio 1.34, reward 1.0) and validate-d183489e (commit 755c50f6, which only adds a guard for a busy machine: 0.0436 mm, 315 to 456 s per instrument, reward 1.0).
